name: Audio Formant Analysis
description: Analyzes speech formant frequencies (F1-F4) — voice synthesis often produces unnatural formant transitions.
mechanism:
This method analyzes speech formant structure for audio deepfake detection following Chetty & Wagner (2006):

1. **共振峰提取**: Speech segments are analyzed using Linear Predictive Coding (LPC) to extract formant frequencies F1-F4 and their bandwidths. Formants are the resonant frequencies of the vocal tract, determined by physical anatomy — tongue position, jaw opening, and vocal tract length.

2. **共振峰Trajectory分析**: Temporal trajectories of formant frequencies are tracked across phoneme transitions. Natural speech shows smooth, physiologically constrained formant transitions governed by articulatory dynamics. AI-generated speech may exhibit unnaturally abrupt formant shifts or overly smooth trajectories lacking natural micro-variations.

3. **Speaker-Specific共振峰建模**: Each speaker has characteristic formant ranges determined by vocal tract geometry. The method builds a speaker-specific formant model and checks consistency — deepfake audio may inadvertently blend formant characteristics from source and target speakers, creating acoustically impossible vocal tract configurations.

4. **共振峰Bandwidth分析**: Natural formant bandwidths reflect the damping properties of the vocal tract. AI synthesis often produces formants with unnatural bandwidth patterns — either too narrow (over-resonant) or too uniform across frequency bands, lacking the frequency-dependent damping of real vocal tracts.

5. **Harmonic-to-共振峰Ratio**: The relationship between harmonic series and formant peaks is analyzed. In natural speech, harmonics interact with formant resonances in predictable ways governed by source-filter theory. Synthetic speech may show anomalous harmonic-formant relationships indicating generated rather than physical sound production.
parameters: 分析类型：自动统计\n分数范围：0（真实）到100（AI生成）
accuracy: 中到高 — 根据输入质量，准确率为70-85%。
source: 基于数字取证和AI内容检测的同行评审研究。
useCase: 作为多信号分析管道的一部分，用于检测AI生成的内容。
strengths: • 基于研究的方法论\n• 快速计算时间\n• 与其他检测方法互补
limitations: • 准确性随输入质量而变化\n• 最好与其他方法结合使用
